summary: Iter 46 — per-module entitlement (trial opens BOTH), yearly savings_pct, admin/member unaffected. BACKEND 5/5 pytest PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iter46_module_entitlement.py: (1) POST /api/studio/register creates a new studio (TEST_iter46_*@example.com / Test1234, firma_adi, kvkk_consent=true) and returns a token; GET /api/studio/me returns account.modules={vesikalik:true, gallery:true} + entitlement.trial_active=true + entitlement.trial_end populated. (2) POST /api/studio/login for the same account works and /studio/me includes 'entitlement' + 'modules'. (3) GET /api/studio/modules/pricing returns 8 pricing rows (2 modules × 4 plans), every row has savings_pct as int > 0, and base_yearly < base_price*12, alongside base_price + base_yearly. (4) admin@fotuber.com.tr /api/studio/me returns modules {vesikalik:true, gallery:true} (admin-super full access). (5) expired@fotuber.com.tr (member) /api/studio/me returns modules with vesikalik=false AND gallery=false (design-only member branch, unaffected). FRONTEND (Playwright): registered a fresh studio via API, /studyo/panel shows 'studio-trial-banner' with '3 Günlük Deneme Aktif' + 'Hem Vesikalık hem Etkinlik Galerisi açık' copy, both studio-module-vesikalik + studio-module-gallery cards visible, studio-module-packages link visible. /studyo/paketler renders both pkg-module-vesikalik and pkg-module-gallery sections with 8 pkg-buy-* rows. Yearly toggle (pkg-period-yearly) works and shows discounted /yıl prices with strikethrough base_yearly. Clicking a Satın Al button triggers POST /api/studio/payments/module/create → 200 (PayTR link returned; no real payment executed).

issues: Backend returns savings_pct per plan row but the UI does not surface a per-row '%X tasarruf' badge on yearly rows — only a global 'Yıllık · ~2 ay bedava' pill above the toggle. Review request explicitly states 'Yıllık fiyatta % tasarruf gösterilir'. Recommend adding a small '%{savings_pct} tasarruf' badge next to the yearly price on each pkg-*-* row.

action_items: Optional: surface savings_pct as a per-row '%X tasarruf' badge on StudioPackages.jsx yearly rows (data is already in API response).
critical_code_review_comments: _module_entitlement grandfathering branch requires 'not mu' (no module_until at all) alongside legacy_active + legacy_mods flag; if a legacy paid_until account ever gets a partial module_until entry, all other modules on that account lose grandfather status. Consider evaluating grandfather per-module independently of whether other modules were purchased.
get_current_studio injects live modules onto acc; downstream endpoints that mutate acc should be careful — the returned dict is a per-request snapshot, not the DB row.
StudioPackages.jsx has no explicit loading/error state handling for /api/studio/modules/pricing (relies on empty list). Minor.
